Frames in Figma are what you may think of as artboards in other design tools. Frames are a foundational element for your designs that act as a top-level container for most things you create in Figma. There are a few different ways to create frames in Figma:
Custom sizes\nCreate custom sized frames by selecting the frame tool and click and drag your cursor to the desired size.
Preset sizes\nCreate frames with preset sizes, e.g. iPhone X, by selecting the preset in the Properties panel on the right-hand side.
Existing elements\nCreate frames from existing elements on the canvas by right-clicking and selecting Frame Selection.
Select the Frame Tool and click and drag along the dotted line to create a new frame.
